activity_summary: Before sleep you said the two leaves had taught you more of the house than Friday had, and that the play had stayed tied. Tomorrow is six, and the barley.

facets.activity: Left the bundle tied and went to sleep

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Two leaves by ten, and I know more of this house tonight than I knew on Friday

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The oilcloth stayed tied all day
